text: @TheGregYang Thanks, makes sense.  Regarding (1), does that hold for the NTK as well?  Wasn’t able to find this in the paper you linked (sorry if I missed it). Intuitively It feels like the “tangent features” from early layers should change the NTK but I have little faith in my intuition

author: Jack_W_Lindsey
text: @TheGregYang This is awesome!  Two questions if you know: (1) how does the GP for vanilla RNNs, T time steps, input only at first time step, differ from that of depth-T MLP? (2) Can you still get GP behavior if weights are sparse? (e.g. w~Gaussian w.p. eps=k/N, else 0, k fixed as N->infinity)
